prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in West Palm Beach FL to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Jeff Tricoli’s team at Keller Williams Realty
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every West Palm Beach home—the right fit depends on your neighborhood, property type, and price range. Based on the available recent agent listings, **Jeff Tricoli’s team at Keller Williams Realty** is one candidate to interview: Realtor.com’s West Palm Beach page lists **34 sales in the last year** and **22 years of experience**. **Ryan Jennings** and **Bill and Stacie Shearouse** also appear among the area’s higher-volume agents.

Before choosing, ask each agent for **recent sales of homes like yours nearby**, their suggested list price and the comparable sales behind it, a marketing plan, and their fees and contract terms. Check that the agent—not just the team—has handled listings in your specific neighborhood and price range. Realtor.com’s agent directory is a useful place to compare profiles and sales history: https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/West-Palm-Beach_FL

If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, home type, and approximate value, I can help narrow down what to look for.
